name: Alltek Technology Corporation
summary: Alltek Technology Corporation operates as a communication components distributor and solution provider in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It offers telecommunications equipment and computer peripherals; wireless communication machinery and equipment manufacturing; and trades in electronic components and testing equipment. The company trades in, imports, and exports radio equipment; and acts as an agent for the products and tender business of domestic and foreign manufacturers. In addition, it designs, manufactures, and sells AIS products and lighting equipment and supplies.
